description: Defines the CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher class, which implements cookie change dispatching and subscription management for CookieMonster, including callback registration, change dispatching, and internal data structures for managing cookie change listeners.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Implements cookie change dispatching, subscription management, and callback handling for cookie changes within the CookieMonster context.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::Subscription
classes.description: Represents individual cookie change subscriptions, manages callback invocation, and handles filtering based on domain, name, and URL.

methods.name: NameKey
methods.description: Generates a key for cookie name-based filtering.

methods.name: DomainKey
methods.description: Generates a key for cookie domain or URL-based filtering.

methods.name: AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to a specific cookie identified by URL and name.

methods.name: AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to cookies associated with a specific URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Registers a callback for all cookie changes.

methods.name: DispatchChange
methods.description: Dispatches a cookie change event to relevant subscribers, optionally notifying global hooks.
